comment: Improve Storybook Docs actions (registered when the now-optional @storybook/addon-docs peer is installed) and Playground declaration resolution, including workspace aliases, active conditional exports and adjacent versioned declarations. Validate build-scoped manifests and JavaScript responses, and support authenticated runtime loading with parallel script downloads and ordered CSS/font inlining in a cacheable content-hashed file, while preserving the opaque sandbox and native Storybook loading.
